claim: Step A test of the 'information bottleneck' hypothesis. Built 45 per-locus annotation features from syn3A.gb (sequence-derived: gravy/pI/aromaticity/charge/AA composition/TM helices/signal peptide; keyword-categorized: 14 functional flags including is_synthetase/is_ribosomal/is_uncharacterized/etc; geometric: length/strand/rel_position). Tested via 5-fold CV logistic regression against Breuer 455-gene essentiality. Headlines: (1) gene-class features ALONE hit MCC = +0.330 strict, +0.242 standard at top-300. Confirms annotation features carry meaningful essentiality signal independent of v15 or LGNN dynamics. (2) Combining with v15 does NOT beat v15 alone in strict mode (0.481 vs 0.530) - v15 already captures most of the same keyword pattern. (3) Surprising win in standard binarization: v15 + gene_class keywords = 0.514 vs v15 alone = 0.471 (+0.043 absolute, +9.1% relative). The Quasiessential category gets a real boost from gene_class keywords because v15 was missing the atp_binding and uncharacterized signals.
source_detail: scripts/build_syn3a_gene_class_features.py parses cell_sim/data/Minimal_Cell_ComplexFormation/input_data/syn3A.gb (CP016816, 543379 bp). Output at memory_bank/data/syn3a_gene_class_features.csv (495 loci x 50 cols). Test method: 5-fold StratifiedKFold cross_val_predict with class_weight='balanced' LogisticRegression. No data leakage (features built from genome only, not from Breuer).

delta_v15_to_v15_plus_keywords_standard.interpretation: Quasiessential category boost: v15 + 14 keyword flags catches more quasi-essentials than v15 alone.

is_uncharacterized_sign_flip.interpretation: Uncharacterized ORFs cluster in Quasiessential category, not Essential. The minimal-genome reduction left mostly genes that contribute to growth robustness without being strictly required for division.

value.regularization_interpretation: Pure AA composition and chemistry features add NO essentiality signal beyond what categorical annotations encode. Only keyword categories + tm_helix_count + has_signal_pep + has_gene_name carry the per-locus signal.

caveats: Gene-class ALONE hits 0.330 strict (just below the 0.35 diagnosis target). The hypothesis 'LGNN was missing annotation features' is partially validated: annotation features carry real signal but v15 already encodes most of it via pattern matching.

The single configuration that BEATS v15 alone is v15 + gene_class keywords in STANDARD binarization (Essential+Quasi positive). MCC went 0.471 -> 0.514 (+0.043). This is the only stack-vs-baseline win across the entire campaign (KO, VAR, M3, v15, gene_class).

Sequence-derived numeric features (AA composition, GRAVY, pI, charge, aromaticity) provide NO signal under L2-regularized logistic regression. They were regularized to ~0 coefficients. Either the signal is too weak after categorical keyword features absorb the variance, or these features are correlated with the keyword categories. Suggests sequence-based features don't add value past the binary 'is_this_class' flags.

is_uncharacterized has OPPOSITE sign in strict vs standard binarization. Strict -0.663 vs standard +0.565. Concrete biology: of 130 uncharacterized loci in Syn3A, most are NOT strictly essential but ARE quasi-essential (contribute to growth robustness under stress). v15 was missing these because it pattern-matches on annotation text and uncharacterized has no annotation to match.

Step A took 1 day of work (parse + test). Per the user's plan, the diagnosis was 'partial': annotation features carry signal (0.33 alone) but don't break the v15 strict ceiling. They DO break the standard ceiling (0.514). Next is Step B (spatial features, 1 week).
